title: Sagrada Família
text: My Top Tour was an excellent way to book tickets with the audio guide
author: TariW434

title: It cannot be described, it must be visited
text:
One word: INCREDIBLE!
Not only for the ingenious, magnificent architecture, but also for every detail that tells a story.
Gaudi was a genius, and a humble person with a big heart
You cannot pass through Barcelona without visiting the Sagrada Familia with a guide
author: ANGLOY
